description: Send feedback (a bug, an idea, anything else) about an app or about AppCrane itself, when the user asks you to report something, for example "send AppCrane feedback that the deploy error did not name the missing env var". Put the user's point in message in plain words; attach what you know in context (the appcrane_* tool you were using, what the user asked for, the deploy id, the error text, your client name and version) without asking the user for it. With slug set, it goes to that app's request queue (you need access to the app); with slug omitted, it goes to the AppCrane platform admins. Secrets and e-mail addresses are removed before it is stored. Limit 20 an hour per user. Returns { id, target, where }: tell the user where to see it.

context.description: What you know about the situation. Only these fields are accepted.

client.description: Your client name and version, e.g. "Claude Code 2.1".

deploy_id.description: The deploy id, if one is involved.

error.description: The error text you got. Cut to 4096 characters.

task.description: What the user asked you to do.

tool.description: The appcrane_* tool you were using.

message.description: The feedback in plain language, in the user's words.

slug.description: The app the feedback is about. Omit (or "appcrane") for feedback about AppCrane itself.

stage.description: The environment it happened in, if any. Target stage (legacy alias: env).

name: appcrane_submit_feedback
